quests.cults_of_tibia.cult_energy_1: Twoje ciało reaguje na tę dziwną zieloną substancję, gdy wyciągasz rękę, aby jej dotknąć. Czujesz potrzebę zdobycia większej ilości tej energii.

quests.cults_of_tibia.ice.msg_1: Wchodząc do lodowej jaskini, czujesz nienaturalny chłód. Lodowate powietrze szczypie Cię w twarz. Przetrwaj i udowodnij, że jesteś godny.

quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_acid.msg_1: Wchodząc do dołów siarkowych, czujesz wokół siebie suche, palące opary siarki. Udowodnij, że jesteś godny, przetrwaj kwas.
quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_acid.msg_2: Siarka pali twoją skórę. Niemal czujesz, jak twoje ciało topi się w kwasie.
quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_acid.msg_3: Palenie kwasem jest teraz nie do zniesienia, skóra przypomina sito. Już prawie nie ma w Tobie sił – działaj szybko!

quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_fire.msg_1: Wchodząc do dołów ze smołą, czujesz, jak ciepło wokół ciebie gwałtownie wzrasta. Przetrwaj upał wystarczająco długo, aby udowodnić, że jesteś tego godny.
quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_fire.msg_2: Twoje ciało się nagrzewa, powietrze wokół ciebie migocze.
quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_fire.msg_3: Upał jest teraz nie do zniesienia, krew w twoim ciele przypomina lawę. Już prawie nie ma w Tobie sił – działaj szybko!
quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_fire.msg_4: Przyjmij piętno złego losu. Smoła nie jest już tak gorąca. Przeszedłeś próbę smoły.
quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_fire.msg_5: Twoje ciało reaguje na tę dziwną zieloną substancję, gdy wyciągasz rękę, aby jej dotknąć. Czujesz potrzebę zdobycia większej ilości tej energii.
quests.cults_of_tibia.tar_fire.msg_6: Pokrywająca cię smoła ostygła i w większości odpadła. Twoje ciało nie jest już rozgrzane.

quests.first_dragon.oasis: Wchodzisz do pięknej oazy. Odwiedzając to święte miejsce, zostajesz napełniony mocą wody ożywiającej pustynię.
quests.first_dragon.suntower: Wszedłeś do słonecznej wieży Ab'dendriela. Odwiedzając to święte miejsce, zostajesz napełniony mocą życiodajnego słońca.
quests.forgotten_knowledge.diamond_entit: 5 diamentowych bytów zużywa zbyt dużo surowej energii, aby kosmiczna komora mogła się obudzić. Za 10 minut zostanie ona ponownie uśpiona.
quests.forgotten_knowledge.golden_entiti: 5 złotych istot zużywa zbyt dużo surowej energii, aby kosmiczna komnata mogła się obudzić. Za 10 minut zostanie ona ponownie zatrzymana.
quests.forgotten_knowledge.lantern_glow: Gdy zaczniesz polerować latarnię, zacznie ona świecić nieziemskim światłem.
quests.forgotten_knowledge.lantern_has_k: W świetle widmowosrebrnej latarni odkrywasz niewidzialne drzwi. Jeśli masz pasujący klucz, możesz przejść.
quests.forgotten_knowledge.lantern_no_ke: W świetle widmowosrebrnej latarni odkrywasz niewidzialne drzwi. Ale brakuje ci klucza, żeby je otworzyć.
quests.globalevents_grimvale_feroxa.broa: Grimvale tonie w stworzeniach-wilkołakach, gdy księżyc w pełni osiąga swój szczyt, a starożytne zło powraca.
quests.grave_danger.defiled: Ten grób jest już zbezczeszczony, a rycerz lisz odszedł! Nic tu nie możesz zrobić.
quests.grave_danger.sanctified: Ten grób został już poświęcony i jest bezpieczny!

quests.gravedigger.monks_msg_1: Cienie powstają i pochłaniają świecę. Posąg migocze w nieziemskim świetle.
quests.gravedigger.monks_msg_3: Pojawia się cień i wyrywa świecę z twoich rąk.

quests.lions_rock.sign_hyaena_1: [EN] With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the golden statue: And the mighty lion defeated the greedy hyaena.
quests.lions_rock.sign_hyaena_2: [EN] As a sign of victory he tooks its blood, red as voracity and lust, and created a precious treasure.
quests.lions_rock.sign_lizard_1: [EN] With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the floor: And the mighty lion defeated the lazy lizard.
quests.lions_rock.sign_lizard_2: [EN] As a sign of victory he tooks its egg, blue as sloth and conceit, and out of a foul creature created a precious treasure.
quests.lions_rock.sign_scorpion_1: [EN] With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the golden altar: And the mighty lion defeated the treacherous scorpion.
quests.lions_rock.sign_scorpion_2: [EN] As a sign of victory he tooks its poison, violet as deceit and betrayal, and created a precious treasure.
quests.lions_rock.sign_snake_1: [EN] With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the floor: And the mighty lion defeated the jealous snake.
quests.lions_rock.sign_snake_2: [EN] As a sign of victory he tooks its eye, yellow as envy and malevolence, and out of a foul creature created a precious treasure.
quests.lions_rock.topaz_flame: [EN] You place the topaz on the small socket. A yellow flame begins to burn.

quests.quest_system2.say_1: [EN] A batch of documents has been stashed in the shelf. These might be of interest to Zalamon.
quests.quest_system2.say_2: [EN] You dig out a skull from the pile of bones. That must be the skull Lazaran talked about.
quests.quest_system2.say_3: [EN] To buy some time you replace the fish with a piece of carrot.
quests.rookie_guard.m02.academy_roof: [EN] These stairs lead up to the roof of the academy. Up there you should find TWO of the catapults.
quests.rookie_guard.m02.house_vascalir: [EN] This is the house Vascalir mentioned. You should find a stone pile in the cellar. Use it to get a stone!
quests.rookie_guard.m02.norma_bar: [EN] This is Norma's bar. If you go to the roof, you should find one of the catapults that need to be filled with stones.
quests.rookie_guard.m02.obi_shop: [EN] This is Obi's shop. Up on his roof you should find one of the catapults Vascalir mentioned.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_hyacinth_eas: [EN] This is not the way to Hyacinth. Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_hyacinth_nor: [EN] This is not the way to Hyacinth. Follow the path to the north exit of the village.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_hyacinth_sta: [EN] This is not the way to Hyacinth. Stay on the path a little more to the north to find Hyacinth's little house.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_lily: [EN] This is not the way to Lily. Follow the road leading to the south-west to find her shop.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.follow_north: [EN] Follow the small path to the north to reach the spider lair.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.not_tarantula_sw: [EN] This is not the way to the tarantula's lair. Head up the little ramp to the southwest.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.remember_web: [EN] Remember that you have to aquire a web sample for Vascalir. You should not leave this cave without it.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.walk_west: [EN] Walk to the west from here to reach the hole leading to the tarantula lair.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.dead_wolf: [EN] There is a dead war wolf! Use the knife, and then use it on its body to get some leather - but quickly!
quests.rookie_guard.m06.exit_time: [EN] You reached the exit in time! Phew.. back to Tom.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.follow_ne: [EN] Follow the north-eastern path into the forest. Beware of wolves!
quests.rookie_guard.m06.not_wolf_stay: [EN] This is not the way into the wolf forest. Stay on the southern path leading to the north-east!
quests.rookie_guard.m06.plans_changed: [EN] It seems plans changed. It's up to you now to find a dead war wolf and use the skinning knife on it to get some leather.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.poacher_dead: [EN] Well.. that seems to be the poacher. Dead. Check his body - maybe he still has something that you can use.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.wolf_den_hole: [EN] This hole leads into the wolves' den. Only enter if you have full health and food - this might be dangerous.
quests.rookie_guard.m07.chest_flames: [EN] This must be the chest with the book - but it's covered in flames!
quests.rookie_guard.m07.rune_table: [EN] Right-click on the grey rune on the table and then left-click on the fire! You can't take the rune, but it works.
quests.rookie_guard.m07.stairs_vault: [EN] Go down the stairs to reach the vault. It smells like fire down there. Make sure you are healthy!
quests.rookie_guard.m07.vault_fire: [EN] The vault is on fire! There is almost no air in here. You don't have much time to find the book. Hurry!
quests.rookie_guard.m09.not_troll_caves: [EN] This is not the way to the troll caves. Go back down the stairs and walk north to find them.
quests.rookie_guard.m09.troll_tunnel: [EN] You've reached the newly dug troll tunnel. Take what you find in this chest and use it to bring down all support beams!
quests.rookie_guard.m09.tunnel_collapsed: [EN] You hear a crumbling below you. The tunnel collapsed. Vascalir will be pleased to hear about that.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.crypt_explore: [EN] This is the crypt Vascalir was talking about. Explore it and search the coffins - one of them must hold a nice fleshy bone.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.deeper_crypt: [EN] This door seems to lead deeper into the crypt. Go downstairs and look for a special coffin. Beware of the walking dead!
quests.rookie_guard.m10.fleshy_bone: [EN] Now that you have a fleshy bone, it's time to find out what Vascalir wanted with it.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.not_crypt: [EN] This is not the way to the crypt. Go south-west to reach the graveyard.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.sarcophagus: [EN] This sarcophagus seems special. Sarcophagi are said to conserve meat longer than normal coffins - maybe you get lucky.
quests.rookie_guard.m11.wasp_tower: [EN] You've found the wasp tower. Kill a wasp and use the flask you got from Vascalir on its corpse to retrieve some of its poison.
quests.rookie_guard.m11.wasps_nest: [EN] Cross the bridge to the west and go south to reach the wasps' nest.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.approaching: [EN] Beware... you're approaching Kraknaknork's room. Once you enter, you have only 5 minutes to kill him before he throws you out.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.chest_items: [EN] This chest should contain everything you need to infiltrate the fortress.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.distraction_bone: [EN] You cannot hope to sneak past this guard. Maybe some distraction would help? You could try using the fleshy bone on him...
quests.rookie_guard.m12.energy_barrier: [EN] Kraknaknork maintains strong energy barriers. There is only one way to disable them.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.guard_pass: [EN] This guard will definitely not let you pass. Sneak around the fortress to find a way to disguise yourself.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.interior: [EN] You've managed to reach the interior of the orc fortress. Be prepared for a fight - and look for the soup cauldron.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.items_infiltrate: [EN] Those items should be what you need to infiltrate the fortress. Go back near the wasps' nest and walk south from there.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.kitchen: [EN] You're apperently in the kitchen. If you find a big cauldron, use the flask of wasp poison on it.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.lever_barrier: [EN] The energy barrier to the south temporarily disappeared.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.no_poison_yet: [EN] You haven't used the poison on Kraknaknork's soup yet. Don't try to fight him before that - or he will definitely kill you.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.orc_break: [EN] This orc has turned his back to you and is obviously taking a break. Use the rolling pin on him to knock him out!
quests.rookie_guard.m12.sneaked_in: [EN] You sneaked into the orc fortress. Careful now, don't go outside again.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.trap_ready: [EN] Got your tarantula trap ready? You might need to use it soon...
quests.rookie_guard.missions.bank_academ: [EN] The bank is below the academy. Go north and head down the stairs and to the right.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.bank_paulie: [EN] Go to the right to find the bank and talk to Paulie.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.graveyard_e: [EN] Follow the way to the east and go south to reach the graveyard.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.hallway_lib: [EN] Head through the northern door and follow the hallways to find the library vault.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.hyacinth_ea: [EN] Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.library_vau: [EN] The library vault is below the academy. Go north and head down several stairs until you find a quest door.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.no_bag_yet: [EN] You don't have the bag with the items yet. Open the door in the basement of the academy to the left of Paulie to get them!
quests.rookie_guard.missions.not_crypt_s: [EN] This is not the way to the crypt. Go south to reach the graveyard.

quests.rookie_guard.missions.not_troll_n: [EN] This is not the way to the troll caves. Follow the path to the north past the hill to reach them.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.not_wasps_n: [EN] This is not the way to the wasps' lair. Choose the northern path to reach it.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.orc_fortres: [EN] Follow the path to the north, cross the bridge to the south and walk west to reach the orc fortress.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.orc_west: [EN] Follow the path to the west to reach the orc fortress.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.road_main: [EN] This road is the main access of the village. You might want to finish your business here first.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.tarantula_s: [EN] Walk to the north and down the stairs to reach the tarantula's lair.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.troll_caves: [EN] Follow the path to the north past the hill to reach the troll caves.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.wasps_bridg: [EN] To reach the wasps' nests follow the path to the north and cross the bridge to the west as if you wanted to reach the spiders.
[EN] Take the southern stairs down the bridge to go to the wasps' lair.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.wasps_west: [EN] Follow the path to the west to find the wasps' lair.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.wolf_forest: [EN] Follow the path east, and when it splits, head north-east to find the wolf forest.

quests.unnatural_selection.mission2_say_: [EN] You hold the skull up high. You can resist the urge to have it look through a telescope though.
[EN] That's definitely one of the highest spots in whole Tibia. If that's not simply perfect you don't know what it is.
[EN] What a beautiful view. Worthy of a Queen indeed! Time to head back to Lazaran and show him what you got.
[EN] You hold up the skull and let it take a peek over the beautiful elven town through the dense leaves.
[EN] Thanita gives you a really strange look as you hold up the skull, but oh well.
[EN] That was a real easy one. And you are used to getting strange looks now, so whatever!
[EN] Wow, it's hot up here. Luckily the skull can't get a sunburn any more, but you can, so you better descend again!
[EN] Considering that higher places around here aren't that easy to reach, you think the view from here is tolerably good.
[EN] Yep, that's a pretty high spot. If Lazaran ever sees what the skull sees, he'd be pretty satisfied with that nice view.
[EN] Well, there are higher spots around here, but none of them is as easily reachable as this one. It just has to suffice.
[EN] Nice! White in white as far as the eye can see. Time to leave before your fingers turn into icicles.
